title: #056. Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP)
subtitle: Dispatch up to K capacitated vehicles from depot 0 to serve every customer once and minimize total route distance.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { routes, totalDistance }.
judge.m1: Field "routes" must be an array of customer routes.
judge.m3: Route {p0} must be an integer array of length at least 3 ([0, ..., 0]).
judge.m4: Route {p0} must start and end at depot 0.
judge.m5: Customer index {p0} is out of valid range [1, {p1}].
judge.m6: Customer {p0} is visited more than once.
judge.m8: Customer {p0} was not visited by any route.
judge.m9: Reported totalDistance ({p0}) does not match computed route distance ({p1}).
judge.m10: Feasible CVRP solution, but totalDistance ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
